_note: Español de España; see topbar.json. The notices list (its button, Clear All, Reload and Keep mine, the strip under a song changed outside), and everything put in a notice or a refusal cue: imports, song packs, bundles, presentations, themes and versions, the library's moves and saves, errors shown in the window, the Settings and Screens windows' titles. Where lang-tables.js of the design has a row (Notices, Clear All, Reload, Keep mine), its Spanish is used.
